description: This file contains classes and functions for managing OpenAI-specific conversation contexts within the Pipecat framework, including message handling, tool management, multimedia content processing, and deprecation notices for transitioning to a universal context system.

classes.name: CustomEncoder
classes.description: Custom JSON encoder for handling io.BytesIO objects and other special data types for logging purposes.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContext
classes.description: Manages conversation context for OpenAI LLM interactions, including message history, tools, and multimedia content, with deprecation notices for migration.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContextFrame
classes.description: A frame containing an OpenAI-specific LLM context, marked as deprecated, used for embedding context in larger processing pipelines.

methods.name: CustomEncoder.default
methods.description: Encodes io.BytesIO objects as hex strings for JSON serialization.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the OpenAI LLM context with optional messages, tools, and tool choice.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.get_llm_adapter
methods.description: Returns the current LLM adapter if set.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.set_llm_adapter
methods.description: Sets the LLM adapter for the context.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.from_messages
methods.description: Creates a new context from a list of message dictionaries.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.messages
methods.description: Property that returns the current list of messages.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.tools
methods.description: Property that returns the tools list, converting via adapter if available.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.tool_choice
methods.description: Property that returns the current tool choice setting.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.add_message
methods.description: Adds a message to the conversation history.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.add_messages
methods.description: Adds multiple messages to the conversation history.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.set_messages
methods.description: Replaces all messages in the context.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.get_messages
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current messages list.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.get_messages_json
methods.description: Returns the messages as a formatted JSON string with custom encoding.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.get_messages_for_logging
methods.description: Returns sanitized messages suitable for logging, with sensitive data truncated.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.from_standard_message
methods.description: Passthrough method for converting a message from standard format.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.to_standard_messages
methods.description: Passthrough method for converting messages to standard format.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.get_messages_for_initializing_history
methods.description: Returns messages for initializing conversation history.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.get_messages_for_persistent_storage
methods.description: Returns messages formatted for persistent storage.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.set_tool_choice
methods.description: Sets the tool choice configuration.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.set_tools
methods.description: Sets the available tools for the context.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.add_image_frame_message
methods.description: Adds a message containing an image frame, encoding image bytes to base64.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.add_audio_frames_message
methods.description: Placeholder for adding audio frames as a message.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContext.create_wav_header
methods.description: Creates a WAV file header for audio data.

methods.name: OpenAILLMContextFrame.__post_init__
methods.description: Post-initialization method that issues deprecation warnings.
